questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Order these steps in a feudal land exchange, from top to bottom
questions.why: Land and power flowed downward: the emperor gave legitimacy, the shogun distributed land to daimyo, daimyo commanded samurai, and samurai protected peasants working the land.
